text:
By what practice, O seeker of the highest goal, were you born from austerities of extreme length?
Until you become the target of the arrow of my desire, O one who is the object of my devotion, residing in my direction.
Who, disagreeing with you, would seek the path of liberation, fleeing from the fear of repeated births?
Let him, bound for a long time, remain captivated by the glances of the beautiful women, whose eyebrows are adorned with four distinct arches.
